reviewGates.notes: Plan approved by project owner. Confirmed decisions adopted for stage cancellation charges, 100% tutor travel surcharge allocation, 100% platform booking fee allocation, 4-digit PIN, and arrival PIN unlock with 5-minute prep grace before billing clock start. 2026-09-14 owner added development cloud deployment policy: deploy affected low-risk functions after code changes; require approval and cost estimate for high-frequency schedules, bulk data operations, payment capture risk, or unclear paid-service exposure. 2026-09-14 user manual testing logged UTR-20260914-01 with changes requested; M7-T3 student mobile stabilization completed (BUG-005, BUG-006, BUG-007 resolved). 2026-09-14 Admin Web manual testing logged UTR-20260914-02: BUG-008 Agreements startTime TypeError (resolved by investigation as browser extension noise), BUG-009 Payouts insufficient permissions (resolved with firestore rules and admin error handling), and BUG-010 sessions index resolved and configured in firestore.indexes.json. M7-T4 Admin Web stabilization completed. 2026-09-14 owner approved launch feature intake: student onboarding requires selfie plus phone/email verification with optional card/cash default; automatic new-account free minutes should be replaced by a 25% first paid lesson discount capped at R50; referral rewards grant 15 free minutes only after referred student completes first paid/discounted lesson; tutor onboarding requires police clearance plus right-to-work ID/passport/work-visa manual admin review; scheduled/recurring lessons and broader rewards remain post-launch planning items. 2026-09-14 owner approved REQ-011 for Student Safety Profile, Guardian Mode for minors, tutor safety badges, and soft same-gender tutor preference matching.

confirmedDecisions.travelSurcharge: R40.00 up to 10 km + R4.00/km beyond 10 km (100% allocated to Tutor)
confirmedDecisions.bookingFee: 1% of lesson-only amount bounded to R1.00 - R2.00 retaining cents (100% allocated to Platform)
confirmedDecisions.revenueSplit: 73% Tutor / 27% Platform for applicable lesson revenue
confirmedDecisions.physicalLessonUnlock: 4-digit one-time PIN confirmation on arrival (Tutor displays, Student enters)
confirmedDecisions.billingStartTrigger: PIN verification confirms arrival/meeting and starts 5-minute preparation grace window; billing clock begins when either user taps Start Lesson or when the 5-minute preparation grace elapses
confirmedDecisions.cancellationStageCharges: Requested/Searching: R0. Accepted <2 min: R0. Accepted >2 min pre-travel: Booking fee (R1-R2) to platform. Travelling: Travel surcharge (100% to tutor) + booking fee to platform. Arrived/Preparing: Travel surcharge (100% to tutor) + 30-min lesson charge (73% tutor / 27% platform) + booking fee to platform. In Session: Elapsed billable time (min 30 min, 73/27 split) + travel surcharge (100% to tutor) + booking fee to platform. Tutor cancellation at any stage: R0 to student, 100% refund.
confirmedDecisions.studentLaunchPromotion: No automatic new-account free minutes. First completed paid lesson receives 25% discount capped at R50 against the full student-facing order total. Referral rewards grant 15 free minutes only after referred student verifies phone/email, completes onboarding, and completes first paid/discounted lesson without cancellation/refund/dispute.
confirmedDecisions.promotionalTutorPayout: For first-time-user promotional lessons only, tutor receives 75% of the discounted total amount paid/settled, inclusive of travel and lesson compensation; this must be disclosed in the Tutor Agreement.
confirmedDecisions.tutorRightToWorkVerification: Tutor approval requires police clearance plus South African ID, or passport plus valid South African work visa/right-to-work evidence, manually reviewed by admin before the tutor can go online or receive requests.
confirmedDecisions.studentSafetyGuardianMode: In-person launch must support Student Safety Profile and Guardian Mode. Minor learners require guardian details, consent/presence confirmation, and safety reminders. Same-gender tutor matching is a soft preference/ranking signal, not a blanket hard exclusion by default.
